## AnyRoute type

Any route: what a graph whose type does not list its routes is taken to have, so that it  refuses no provider at compile time and leaves `HG_NO_ROUTE` to the run.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type AnyRoute = Route<string, ProviderBase>;
```
**References:** [Route](./hopgraph.route.md)<!-- -->, [ProviderBase](./hopgraph.providerbase.md)
